text:
Aisha: quick brainstorm: propose an 'Adaptive Guidance (Lite)' epic under Optimize toolkit. focused MVP = route-level batching + cache TTL suggestions + a conservative quantization profiler + eval-triggered drift alerts. want to align scope and launch gates.
Marco: sounds good. for MVP let's keep it offline recommendations only, no live auto-tuning. helps reduce blast radius and infra complexity.
Eve: +1. remind we need clear customer personas: low-latency payments, high-throughput embedders, and exploratory dev teams. the recs should be labeled by persona.
Kai: infra notes: offline sampler + model profile DB + cost model. sampling must preserve sequence length distribution. estimate one small k8s job cluster and object storage for samples.
Ruth: compliance ask: for private deploys we should deliver a container that runs inside customer VPC and emits only anonymized telemetry. Hosted can accept hashed prompt signatures.
Aisha: UX idea: single recommendations CSV with columns: route, recommended_action, estimated_monthly_savings_usd, confidence_score, risk_note, suggested_validation_steps. UI: one-line summary + expand to sample examples and how to validate.
Marco: API sketch (read-only for MVP):
```
POST /v1/optimize/lite/analyze
{ "route": "checkout/complete", "lookback": "72h", "persona": "payments" }

Response 200:
{ "analysis_id": "aid_123", "summary": [{"action":"increase_batch","value":8,"savings_usd":120.50,"confidence":0.65,"risk":"possible latency spike on single-token paths"}], "report_url":"/reports/aid_123.csv" }
```
Eve: include a small validation checklist per recommendation: sample prompts to rerun, target metrics, acceptable deltas (e.g., loss in eval concordance <= 3%).
Kai: eval-triggered alerts idea: two modes: 1) perf alerts (p95 latency up, tokens/sec down), 2) quality alerts (embedding-drift or eval-set concordance drop). quality detection: run mini-eval suite every 15m on canaries.
Ruth: security gate: any alerting that includes prompt content must be opt-in for hosted. default = no prompt text.
Aisha: acceptance criteria draft:
- Can generate recommendations for at least 3 customer archetypes (payments/chat/embed) from a 72h sample
- Estimated token or runtime cost savings >= 8% for at least one pilot customer without >3% eval concordance degradation
- Automated alerting (email/slack) surfaces quality regressions within 30m of detection turnaround
- Delivered private-runner container that runs without exporting raw prompts
Marco: timeline proposal:
- Spec + data contract: 10 days (owners: Aisha, Kai)
- Sampler + offline reporter: 3 weeks (owner: Kai)
- Recommendations scoring + cost-model: 2 weeks (owner: Marco)
- Eval hook & alert plumbing: 2 weeks (owner: Eve)
- Pilot: weeks 8-10, then iterate and decide GA.
Kai: infra ask: 1 infra eng (0.5 FTE) + 1 ML infra (0.5 FTE) for pilot; storage cost ~ $1k/mo for samples, plus ephemeral compute.
Ruth: I'll prep a short pilot intake template listing required telemetry, privacy knobs, and SLO constraints.
Aisha: risks: quantization profiling offline may miss long-tail prompt behaviors. mitigation: include a recommended A/B validation checklist and a conservative safe preset (e.g., "safe-q4").
Eve: also call out UX for opting into alerts + simple explainability: why this recommendation? show top 3 signals that drove it.
Marco: acceptance thresholds need a check: how do we measure user-visible quality? propose: use customer-provided eval sets + a small sample of live traffic human-check for payments.
OpsBot: ops-bot: created ticket OPT-LITE-17 "Adaptive Guidance (Lite) MVP spec" and assigned to Aisha, Kai, Marco, Eve.
Aisha: next steps: Marco -> cost & model equations by 2026-04-05, Kai -> sampler prototype + data schema by 2026-04-05, Eve -> eval suite + alert definitions by 2026-04-07, Ruth -> pilot intake doc by 2026-04-07.
Ruth: I'll loop in product marketing for pilot comms after we lock the intake doc.
Marco: small question: do we expose per-token savings or per-route $ estimates? prefer both but default to per-route $ to be actionable.
Eve: agree. also include a recommended validation harness and a one-click revert plan for pilots.
Aisha: great, will convert this thread into a living spec and ping for review. thanks everyone.
Kai: ack, will post infra sketch shortly.
Ruth: ack.
Marco: ack :rocket:
